deficiencies.description: The text states that tumours lead to 'erosion of that bone function', which the rewrite changes to 'erosion of the bone'. Resolving an unclear or loose phrasing into a conventional scientific reading is a forbidden change.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: if tumors in bones lead to erosion of that bone function, so you can get fractures
deficiencies.rewritePassage: Tumours in bones lead to erosion of the bone, so that fractures can occur

deficiencies.description: The rewrite inserts 'therefore' to create a causal connection between the niche not being very big and the tumour interfering with the bone marrow, whereas the source text merely juxtaposes the two statements.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: This niche is not very big. This will interfere with your bone marrow, and it will result in things like infection and anemia as well.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: This niche is not very big. The tumour will therefore interfere with the bone marrow, and this results in infection and anaemia as well.
